WITH T1 AS (
  SELECT "Child ID", "Child Name", "Age", "Location", "Coach", "Shuttle Run sec", "Sit Ups" 
  FROM "sportathon_baseline"

  SELECT "Child ID", "Child Name", "Age", "Location", "Coach", "Shuttle Run sec", "Sit Ups" 
  FROM "sportathon_endline"
)
SELECT T1."Child ID", T1."Child Name", T1."Age", T1."Location", T1."Coach", 
       T1."Shuttle Run sec", T1."Sit Ups", 
       T2."Sit Ups" - T1."Sit Ups" AS "Situp Count Change"
FROM T1
JOIN T2 ON T1."Child ID" = T2."Child ID"
WHERE T1."Sit Ups" IS NOT NULL AND T2."Sit Ups" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY T2."Sit Ups" - T1."Sit Ups" DESC
LIMIT 5;
